What we treat

Ant & rodent control for King County homes

From little black ants in the kitchen to carpenter ants in the walls — and the moisture problems they warn you about.

Ant Control

Little black ants in kitchens and bathrooms, odorous house ants and sugar ants — identified correctly first, because treatment depends on the species.

Carpenter Ant Control

Large ants in wood, frass near window frames and decks, activity at night — inspection first, so foraging is never confused with nesting.

Rodent Control

Mice and rats in crawlspaces and wall voids — inspection, trapping and monitoring, plus the entry points that let them in.

WDO Inspections

Certified wood-destroying-organism inspections for real estate transactions across King County — the inspection general home inspectors can't do.

Quarterly Prevention

A quarterly prevention plan that keeps ants and rodents from coming back — with a free moisture meter assessment on every moisture ant visit.

Moisture Ant Treatment

Moisture ants nest only in wet wood — a sighting is often the first warning of a hidden water problem. We find the water source, not just the ants.

About AMPM

Twenty years of treating ants across King County

AMPM Exterminators has spent twenty years treating ant infestations throughout King County — from pre-1940 homes in Ballard and Wallingford to new construction in Sammamish and Issaquah. We document every location of ant activity, so your electrician or contractor knows exactly what was found.

  • Correct identification first — carpenter, moisture, pavement and sugar ants each get different treatment.
  • Moisture meter assessment — every moisture ant treatment includes a free check for the water source.
  • Real estate inspections — certified WDO inspections for buyers and sellers.
  • Honest costs — a treatment done at the first sighting costs far less than the repair bill a year later.
How it works

Three steps to an ant-free home

1

Free inspection

We inspect your home, identify the species and find where they're entering — including a moisture meter assessment when moisture ants are involved.

2

Targeted treatment

Treatment depends on the species, nest location and conditions around your property. No guesswork, no blanket spraying.

3

Prevention that lasts

Entry points sealed, conditions addressed and a quarterly plan available — so the problem stays solved.
